title: Vampire Vape Shortz Highland Soda
description: A truly inspired flavour from Vampire Vape’s Shortz collection, Highland Soda is a unique e-liquid that evokes the fizzy brew beloved by Scots with a distinct Orange flavour that bubbles over your tastebuds. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well.
